bugs.name: Refresh Interval accepts zero seconds without validation
bugs.summary: The spinbutton accepts value "0" and the helper says, "The status page will do a full site refresh every 0 seconds," with no validation message.
bugs.expected: The Refresh Interval should reject or validate zero and show corrective feedback because a zero-second refresh interval is not a usable positive interval.
bugs.actual: The spinbutton accepts value "0" and the helper says, "The status page will do a full site refresh every 0 seconds," with no validation message.
reproSteps: Select New Status Page and create a uniquely named page.
In the editor, enter 0 in Refresh Interval.
bugs.reason: The numeric field sets a minimum and runtime intervals clamp to at least five seconds. Entering a transient draft zero, without Save, does not establish that zero is accepted on save or runs as a zero-second refresh. Existing below-minimum runtime ground truth needs a separate audit.
